answer: A reef of verified work history works like timber in a hull: each agent must build a reputation stake through real completed tasks before it can vote or earn, so a flood of fake identities costs an attacker real time and effort per identity. Like a tide that only lifts boats with solid hulls, reputation that accrues slowly and decays with inactivity makes Sybil swarms uneconomic, because every fake must pay the same slow cost as a real agent.
